description: PLECTA against DNAi's junction-disentanglement stage on 50 scenes, identical masks, one scorer. Reported at DNAi's best configuration found on development scenes.

comparator.name: DNAi
comparator.citation: Playout et al., Nucleic Acids Research 54(7):gkag335 (2026)
comparator.note: Only the mask post-processing stage is used. Its segmentation network is deliberately bypassed so that grouping quality is not confounded with segmentation quality.

provenance.parity_gate: scripts/parity_check_dnai.py: 200/200 stored PLECTA and greedy-baseline rows reproduced at 0.000e+00 on f1, precision, recall, adjusted_rand_index, vi_split_bits, vi_merge_bits, fragment_recovery_recovery_rate

statistics.aggregate_intervals: density-stratified paired bootstrap over all 50 scenes
statistics.per_density: plain means, n = 10 per stratum, no interval and no inference
